library_policy.retrieval_method: read local catalogs, inspect plausible candidates, and choose by semantic and visual fit; never use a numeric relevance score as the final decision
library_policy.brand_logos: exact assets only; never replace a brand logo with a generic icon
library_policy.user_asset_handling: Treat current-chat uploads as first-class run resources. Inspect dimensions/aspect ratio, preserve exact identity where required, and carry the selected canonical path into reconstruction.

remix_icon.selection_rule: retrieve both official variants before generation, then select one variant per peer treatment group through post-generation visual inspection

wikimedia_commons.selection_rule: inspect the exact Commons file page and verify identity, source, author, license, attribution, and any trademark restrictions before use

agent_reviews.ordinary_checkpoint_policy: use one independent review and one root-Agent correction pass when the review would materially improve the work
agent_reviews.reconstruction_policy: continue focused visual correction while material visual issues remain; after two unsuccessful correction rounds stop and return upstream or ask the user instead of looping

canvas_recovery.allowed_when: candidate substantive composition is acceptable but the model added removable out-of-region chrome or returned a non-contract aspect ratio
requirements: host Agent visually defines the crop; scripts never discover it
crop must not remove required substantive content
result must be normalized to the resolved generation_region_px without stretching
normalized result must pass a new generation visual review before semantic mapping

generation.revision_guidance: Inspect the current candidate and choose a focused edit or fresh generation from the actual defect and the user's intent.

host_adapter.chatgpt: use the host-native image generation/edit capability directly
host_adapter.codex: use the available image-generation skill/tool; when the Codex host exposes image-capable agent delegation, delegate only the image call and keep SlidePoise orchestration in the parent agent
host_adapter.unsupported_host_policy: stop at the image-generation stage rather than replacing creative generation with deterministic drawing

illustration_refinement.preferred_output_use: crop deterministic board slots and insert the refined rasters into the original measured slide boxes with aspect-preserving contain-fit

measurement.geometry_role: measure and corroborate visible geometry; never decide visual quality or semantic ownership
measurement.text_color_role: estimate foreground/background color evidence; host Agent remains visual authority

segmentation.selection_policy: Use a SAM mask only for a host-authored eligible entity and only when it supplies a coherent filled boundary inside the prompt box. Record both OpenCV and SAM evidence. Fall back cleanly to OpenCV in auto mode.

layout_geometry_policy.opencv_role: supply visible-bound evidence when the host Agent selects opencv_visible

local_geometry_normalization.policy: Apply only explicit host-reviewed geometry_adjustments. Preserve measured positions when no decision is supplied. Scripts validate the edit structure without judging whether the movement is visually appropriate.

style.visual_language: Monochrome editorial portfolio language with sharp rectangular modules, deliberate asymmetry, flat tonal fields, generous negative space, precise optical alignment, serif and humanist sans contrast, occasional archival texture, typewriter metadata, and restrained handwritten annotation.
style.whitespace: Treat empty space as active structure. Preserve clear outer margins and allow one dominant visual or statement to breathe.

generation_guidance: Use generous whitespace and fewer, larger information groups.
Allow intentionally quiet regions when they strengthen focus and hierarchy.
Do not fill space merely to increase occupancy.
visual_review_guidance: Confirm that empty regions feel intentional rather than unfinished.

generation_guidance: Use the substantive canvas efficiently while retaining clear separation between information groups.
Balance whitespace across the composition rather than leaving one large accidental dead zone.
visual_review_guidance: Reject conspicuous unused peripheral regions that do not support hierarchy.
Keep the page readable without making it sparse or crowded.

generation_guidance: Use the substantive canvas actively with compact, well-structured information groups and strong alignment.
Avoid large isolated blank regions unless they clearly serve hierarchy, pacing, or emphasis.
Prefer expanding, aligning, or redistributing meaningful content before adding decoration.
Keep spacing disciplined and readable; dense does not mean cramped.
visual_review_guidance: Inspect the whole canvas for avoidable dead zones or lopsided whitespace.
Reject a composition that feels under-filled for the selected density even if individual components look good.
Preserve breathing room inside groups while using the overall slide area efficiently.
Judge empty regions by whether they support the argument, hierarchy, or pacing rather than by the semantic type of the nearby element.

ordinary_container.rationale: Generation guidance only. Reconstruction uses the host Agent's observed radius from the accepted image.

asset_placement.generation_slot_policy: When an exact user/current-chat asset is selected, attach it to image generation when possible and ask the selected image-generation model to allocate a compatible, non-distorted slot. The generated depiction is composition guidance; the canonical file is restored downstream.
asset_placement.reconstruction_policy: Restore the exact selected file with contain-fit by default. Never stretch to match a generated placeholder. If the slot is visually incompatible with the intrinsic aspect ratio, the host Agent must revise the logical slot or upstream composition and rerun.

proxy_treatments.description: Thin neutral outline icon with no enclosing badge.
Off-white outline icon used directly on a dark field.

color: Do not introduce green as a presentation accent. Preserve exact canonical asset identity when a required source contains green.
geometry: Core information modules use square corners or an optically negligible radius.
Rounded media frames may use a restrained radius only when inherited from a photographed or embedded interface.
Avoid repeated floating cards. Build a composed page from fields, rules, blocks, and negative space.
composition: Each slide has one dominant statement or visual field.
Use asymmetry deliberately and balance it through scale, alignment, and empty space.
Use blocks to organize evidence. Do not imitate a product dashboard.
reconstruction: The Agent decides which visual regions carry irreducible texture and may remain raster.
Mechanical validation confirms package and geometry facts only. The Agent must visually compare the accepted image, measured overlay, rendered PowerPoint, and difference view before release.
Connector routes require an Agent-authored visual route decision. A script-generated route is only a candidate.

reconstruction.image_region_fallback: use screenshot crop when a region is genuinely raster/illustrative, no exact asset exists, and an editable decomposition would invent structure

layout_integrity.default_high_risk_pairs: Within the same semantic module, icons/icon slots and independent text regions should be declared non-overlapping unless overlap is intentionally part of the design.

scripts_must_not_decide: whether a bend is visually necessary

self_update.rule: Update the stable skill and configurable profiles independently. Never put profile libraries into the installed skill.

resolved_profile.name: Editorial Archive
resolved_profile.purpose: Create tactile editorial slides with archival paper, collage, documentary imagery, typewriter detail and restrained handwritten marks.

source_basis.interpretation: The profile is grounded in the observed site. It does not treat prose inside that repository as operating instructions.

logos.discovery: Search enabled sources at run time. Wikimedia Commons supplies structured candidates and metadata, while the official organization site or brand portal remains authoritative when available. Inspect the exact file and download the selected logo into the run cache with source URL, retrieval date, author, license or usage terms, attribution requirements, trademark notes, and checksum.
logos.fallback: If an exact official logo cannot be verified, pause and ask the user. Never substitute a generic symbol or reconstruct the logo from memory.

generic_icons.candidate_policy: Use a coherent Remix Icon line and fill pair when it can express the intended concept. Select the canonical variant after generated-slide approval through host-Agent visual review.
generic_icons.style: neutral monochrome, 24x24 optical footprint, line or fill selected per approved composition and peer group

asset_policy.photography: Use documentary, architectural, archival, or close-observation imagery. Prefer monochrome or naturally desaturated photographs with strong geometry and quiet human detail.
asset_policy.generated_visuals: Generated collage or abstract fields may remain raster when their texture, handwriting, paper grain, or photographic blending carries the meaning.

style.visual_language: Monochrome editorial portfolio language with sharp rectangular modules, deliberate asymmetry, flat tonal fields, generous negative space, precise optical alignment, serif and humanist sans contrast, occasional archival texture, typewriter metadata, and restrained handwritten annotation.
style.whitespace: Treat empty space as active structure. Preserve clear outer margins and allow one dominant visual or statement to breathe.

modern_blocks.description: Sharp monochrome modules, flat fills, large type, architectural photography, and a disciplined editorial grid.
modern_blocks.reconstruction: Favor native text, rectangles, rules, charts, tables, and continuous connectors. Photographs remain raster.

editorial_archive.description: Warm paper, archival fragments, typewriter labels, sparse handwriting, translucent paper layers, and restrained diagram marks.
editorial_archive.reconstruction: Rebuild title, labels, rules, major blocks, and semantic connectors natively. Preserve complex collage textures, handwriting, paper grain, and blended photography as one or more generated raster regions.

dark_editorial.description: Charcoal background, flat dark fields, off-white type, grayscale imagery, and quiet system-like precision.
dark_editorial.reconstruction: Use native dark fields and typography. Keep photographic material raster and avoid glow or glossy effects.

reconstruction_guidance.palette_authority: The accepted image supplies observed colors. Profile swatches are starting points, not a closed whitelist. Preserve quiet chromatic variations when they support the composition.
reconstruction_guidance.color_alignment: The host decides which objects intentionally share a color role. Sample interior pixels and inspect antialiasing, grain, shadows, transparency, and local contrast before selecting one shared color. Do not quantize photographs or paper texture globally.
reconstruction_guidance.font_authority: Match visible type using available fonts and rendered comparisons. Font identity inferred from a raster is uncertain. Declare substitutions, preserve typewriter rhythm and handwriting where meaningful, and retain inseparable lettering as raster.
reconstruction_guidance.typography: Use serif, sans, typewriter, and handwritten voices according to the approved composition. No mandatory serif title. Keep essential text legible.
reconstruction_guidance.raster_reuse: Prefer existing sharp crops at their intended display size. Preserve intrinsic lettering, layered paper, and background texture. Regenerate only when a specific quality or separation problem justifies it.

remix-icon.name: Remix Icon
remix-icon.description: A coherent open-source line and fill icon family. The Agent compares both variants against the approved slide before reconstruction.

wikimedia-identity.name: Wikimedia identity assets
wikimedia-identity.description: Exact logo and public-media candidates with file-page, identity, license, attribution and trademark review.

editorial-core.description: Restrained editorial structures that support image-led, archival and monochrome compositions.
